candidate.title: Cancel booking fallback loads Credential without app slug/name, breaking getCalendar resolution
reports: packages/features/bookings/lib/handlecancelbooking.ts:638 — the db fallback foundcalendarcredential = await prisma.credential.findunique({ where: { id: credentialid } }) does not select/attach app.slug/appname (unlike the parallel fix in packages/core/eventmanager.ts which explicitly fetches app: { select: { slug: true } } and builds appname), so calendarcredential passed to getcalendar is missing the appname field needed to resolve the calendar app.

handlecancelbooking db-fetched credential lacks appname for getcalendar (packages/features/bookings/lib/handlecancelbooking.ts:~432-441) — the fallback passes the raw prisma credential to getcalendar, unlike the parallel new code in eventmanager.ts which deliberately reconstructs { appname: app.slug, ... }; this path is now reachable for collective bookings whose references carry member credentialids, so canceling a multi-host booking can fail to resolve the calendar service and leave member-host events undeleted.
